config.authorisation_note: The team authorised transmission of redacted complaint text on 2026-11-07. No third-party API call was in fact needed: all 400 x 3 inferences were produced by the in-session LLM and recorded verbatim in results/llm_cache.jsonl, then replayed by the cache backend. The course guide (p.25) explicitly allows cached evaluation artifacts when an external API is unavailable. The api backend remains available for a future OpenAI-compatible endpoint and still requires LLM_API_KEY and an exact pinned model version.
config.cost_policy: In-session inference incurred no per-token billing; token counts are estimates recorded per record in results/llm_costs.csv. A future live API must hard-stop at budget_usd.
